name: Theoretical Capacity Calculator
description: Calculate theoretical specific capacity from a chemical formula and a manually supplied electron-transfer number, using the original TMCCDB browser calculation.
features: Browser-local calculation of Q = nF / (3.6M) in mAh/g
Shared formula parser and atomic weights from TMCCDB
Displays molar mass, electron count and substituted equation
Electron count is supplied by the user; no automatic oxidation-state inference

history.notes: Added the TMCCDB theoretical capacity calculator to AimatraLab with its original scientific calculation.

zh.description: 根据化学式和手动输入的电子转移数计算理论比容量，保留 TMCCDB 原有的浏览器计算方法。
features: 在浏览器本地按 Q = nF / (3.6M) 计算比容量，单位为 mAh/g
沿用 TMCCDB 的化学式解析与原子量数据
显示摩尔质量、电子转移数及代入后的公式
